justifications.durability: the added test pins the install-path probe count behaviourally and reddens on the exact regression it guards. Docked one point because its counter is visible only through the two directly-imported probe names it monkeypatches (remote_tools and remote_python), so a future re-import style for `probe_remote_environment` could silently stop being counted; and no standalone test pins `create_venv`'s single probe when it is called directly with `environment` omitted, though that path probes once by construction.
justifications.evidence: the invariant is measured by a test and independently reproduced. `test_install_probes_the_environment_once` (tests/cli/test_tools_status_environment.py:202) counts calls to `probe_remote_environment` across a full `setup_python_env` run and asserts one. Head arm re-run by this review in a scratch extraction of e14edf6d (head-arm-repro.log: module.__file__ under the scratch tree, 133 passed, EXIT=0); the negative control that reverts the hand-off reddens it (negative-control-repro.log: 'expected one probe, saw 2', EXIT=1). The reviewed run's own suite logs agree: base-arm.log (8736d628d, 124 passed, EXIT=0) and gate.log (e14edf6d, 133 passed, EXIT=0).
justifications.fit: `environment` is a capability-named parameter carrying a mechanism docstring (python.py:450-455), the inline comment states the invariant (python.py:494-495), and the test name `test_install_probes_the_environment_once` names behaviour; no plan label, sprint id, ticket reference or author attribution appears in the delta.
justifications.goal_fidelity: the delta delivers exactly its title — one environment probe across the install path. `create_venv` (python.py:437,442) accepts an already-resolved `environment`; `setup_python_env` probes once at python.py:625 and hands that mapping into the venv step at python.py:677-681, so `imas-codex tools install <facility>` now opens the remote environment once. The probe sites reached by the install path are exactly `_probe_facility_environment` (python.py:156) at python.py:625; `check_tool`, `install_uv` and `install_python` do not probe, and `tools install` calls `install_tool` + `setup_python_env` rather than `check_all_tools`, so no second probe is reachable. This repairs the prior review's python.py:670 follow-on finding.
justifications.reuse: the delta extends the existing single-probe mechanism — the `_probe_facility_environment`/`environment=` threading already present on `get_python_status` — rather than introducing a second probe path or a wrapper, and no duplicate probe-or-None helper is forked.
justifications.scope_discipline: the delta d3643e2d..e14edf6d touches exactly the two declared paths — imas_codex/remote/python.py and tests/cli/test_tools_status_environment.py — and nothing else (git diff --stat: 2 files, 53 insertions, 6 deletions).
